preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output must either be '-1' or contain n lines representing the edges of a tree.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(u) <= n and 1 <= int(v) <= n for u, v in edges)
postconditions.description: Each edge must connect two valid nodes within the range [1, n].
A valid tree with n nodes must have exactly n-1 edges.
The edges must form a connected acyclic graph (a tree).
